verdicts.reason: A: the hashtag bar is clipped to an odd partial-width box flush against the top-left. The symptom list and CTA are jammed into the bottom third with almost no margin to the canvas edge, "cough" is orphaned, and the list text nearly matches the headline in size. B: the symptom list is tiny and its line breaks are destroyed ("Sore throat Headache" runs together on one line, "Shortness of breath Dry / cough"), so it no longer reads as a list. Its spacing is uneven, with dead gaps between blocks, though the hashtag badge and CTA margins are cleaner. A is more readable, so it is the less bad of the two.
